newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeking 8,000 tonnes SRW wheat for Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeking 8,000 tonnes SRW wheat for Jamaica.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corporation said it will tender on September 12 for 8,000 tonnes of U.S. soft red winter wheat for donation to Jamaica.
The wheat is for shipment between October 5 and 30, 1996.
CCC seeks U.S. number 2 or better SRW wheat, maximum 13.5 percent moisture and dockage not to exceed 1.0 percent.
CCC has put a limit of 2 parts per million vomitoxin content, with phytosanitary certificate required.
Offers are due at 1500 hrs EDT (2000 GMT) on Sept 12 with results scheduled for the next morning.
